Q01: SELECT COUNT(*) AS hub_count FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1
Q02: SELECT l.kennz, l.baujahr FROM lfz l WHERE l.stat = 'active' AND l.baujahr >= 2015 ORDER BY l.baujahr DESC, l.kennz ASC
Q03: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_flights FROM flug WHERE stat = 'cancelled'
Q04: SELECT mdl, max_nutzl_kg FROM lfz_typ ORDER BY max_nutzl_kg DESC
Q05: SELECT SUM(dekl_wert_usd) AS total_declared_value_usd FROM sndg WHERE stat = 'delivered' AND waren_kat = 'pharmaceuticals'
Q06: SELECT name1, land FROM knd_stamm WHERE zahlbed_tg = 45 ORDER BY name1, land
Q07: SELECT stat AS status, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM sndg GROUP BY stat ORDER BY status
Q08: SELECT kennz FROM lfz WHERE lfz_nr NOT IN (SELECT lfz_nr FROM flug) ORDER BY kennz
Q09: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_fra_departures FROM flug WHERE abfl_ist IS NOT NULL AND abfl_pos = 'FRA' AND stat = 'completed'
Q10: SELECT flgesbez, COUNT(flg.stat) AS completed_flights FROM flges LEFT JOIN flug flg ON flges.flges_nr = flg.flges_nr AND flg.stat = 'completed' LEFT JOIN flghf flgh ON flg.abfl_fh = flgh.fh_nr GROUP BY flgesbez ORDER BY completed_flights DESC, flgesbez
Q11: SELECT k.kunnr AS customer_id, k.name1 AS name, ROUND(SUM(s.dekl_wert_usd), 2) AS total_declared_value_usd FROM knd_stamm k JOIN sndg s ON k.kunnr = s.kunnr WHERE s.stat != 'cancelled' GROUP BY k.kunnr, k.name1 ORDER BY total_declared_value_usd DESC, k.kunnr ASC LIMIT 5
Q12: SELECT iata_cd, COUNT(*) AS completed_arrivals FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed' GROUP BY iata_cd HAVING COUNT(*) > 150 ORDER BY completed_arrivals DESC, iata_cd ASC
Q13: SELECT f.ort, AVG(julianday(f.ank_ist) - julianday(f.abfl_plan)) * 1440 AS avg_departure_delay_min FROM flug f WHERE f.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY f.ort HAVING COUNT(f.flug_id) >= 40 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay_min DESC, f.ort
Q14: SELECT kunnr, name1 FROM knd_stamm WHERE kunnr NOT IN (SELECT kunnr FROM sndg WHERE stat != 'cancelled') ORDER BY kunnr
Q15: SELECT kunnr AS customer_id, SUM(fracht_usd) AS total_invoiced_usd, SUM(COALESCE(betr_usd, 0)) AS total_paid_usd, ROUND(SUM(fracht_usd) - SUM(COALESCE(betr_usd, 0)), 2) AS outstanding_usd FROM rech_kopf LEFT JOIN zahlg ON rech_kopf.rech_id = zahlg.rech_id GROUP BY kunnr HAVING outstanding_usd > 0 ORDER BY outstanding_usd DESC LIMIT 10
Q16: SELECT s.serv_lvl AS service_level, COUNT(*) AS connecting_shipments FROM sndg s JOIN flug_ladg fl ON s.sndg_nr = fl.sndg_nr WHERE fl.abschn_stat = 'flown' GROUP BY s.serv_lvl ORDER BY s.serv_lvl
Q17: SELECT lft.mdl, ROUND(SUM(snd.fracht_gew_kg) * 100 / lft.max_nutzl_kg, 1) AS avg_load_factor_pct FROM lfz_typ lft JOIN lfz l ON lft.typ_nr = l.typ_nr JOIN flug_ladg flg_l ON l.lfz_nr = flg_l.lfz_nr JOIN sndg snd ON flg_l.sndg_nr = snd.sndg_nr WHERE flg_l.abschn_stat = 'flown' AND snd.fracht_gew_kg > 0 GROUP BY lft.mdl ORDER BY avg_load_factor_pct DESC
Q18: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', T1.abfl_plan) AS month, ROUND(SUM(T2.fracht_gew_kg), 1) AS total_kg_flown FROM flug AS T1 JOIN sndg AS T2 ON T1.flugnr = T2.flugnr WHERE T1.stat = 'completed' AND T2.stat = 'delivered' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
Q19: SELECT f1.iata_cd AS origin_iata, f2.iata_cd AS destination_iata, COUNT(f2.flug_id) AS completed_flights FROM flghf f1 JOIN flug f ON f.abfl_fh = f1(fh_nr) JOIN flghf f2 ON f.ziel_fh = f2(fh_nr) WHERE f.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY f1.iata_cd, f2.iata_cd ORDER BY f1.iata_cd, f2.iata_cd
Q20: SELECT sndg_nr AS shipment_id, ROUND((strftime('%s', ank_ist) - strftime('%s', ank_plan)) / 3600, 1) AS hours_late FROM flug_ladg JOIN flug ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr WHERE sndg.stat = 'delivered' ORDER BY ank_ist DESC, sndg_nr ASC LIMIT 10
Q21: SELECT kunnr, name1 FROM knd_stamm WHERE kunnr IN (SELECT kunnr FROM sndg WHERE stat = 'delivered') AND kunnr NOT IN (SELECT kunnr FROM vorf WHERE stat = 'approved' OR stat = 'rejected' OR stat = 'paid') ORDER BY kunnr
Q22: SELECT kunnr AS customer_id, MAX(buch_dat) AS latest_booking_date, MAX(sndg_nr) AS shipment_id FROM sndg GROUP BY kunnr ORDER BY customer_id
Q23: SELECT r.belnr AS invoice_id, k.name1 AS customer_name, julianday('2025-12-20') - julianday(r.ausst_dat) AS days_overdue, ROUND(SUM(r.fracht_usd) - SUM(z.betr_usd), 2) AS outstanding_usd FROM rech_kopf r JOIN knd_stamm k ON r.kunnr = k.kunnr LEFT JOIN zahlg z ON r.rech_id = z.rech_id WHERE r.ausst_dat < '2025-12-20' AND (z.betr_usd IS NULL OR z.betr_usd < r.fracht_usd) GROUP BY r.belnr, k.name1 ORDER BY days_overdue DESC, r.belnr ASC LIMIT 10
Q24: SELECT s.waren_kat AS commodity_category, COUNT(DISTINCT f.fh_nr) AS flown_legs, COUNT(v.vorf_id) AS incidents, ROUND(COUNT(v.vorf_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.fh_nr), 4) AS incident_rate FROM sndg s LEFT JOIN flug_ladg fl ON s.sndg_nr = fl.sndg_nr LEFT JOIN flug f ON fl.flug_id = f.flug_id LEFT JOIN vorf v ON fl.ladg_id = v.ladg_id WHERE fl.leg_status = 'flown' GROUP BY s.waren_kat ORDER BY incident_rate DESC, commodity_category
Q25: SELECT a1.iata_cd AS airport_a, a2.iata_cd AS airport_b, COUNT(CASE WHEN f1.abfl_fh = a1.fh_nr AND f1.ank_ist IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS flights_a_to_b, COUNT(CASE WHEN f2.abfl_fh = a2.fh_nr AND f2.ank_ist IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS flights_b_to_a FROM flghf a1 JOIN flghf a2 ON a1.iata_cd < a2.iata_cd LEFT JOIN flug f1 ON a1.fh_nr = f1.abfl_fh AND a2.fh_nr = f1.ank_fh LEFT JOIN flug f2 ON a2.fh_nr = f2.abfl_fh AND a1.fh_nr = f2.ank_fh WHERE f1.stat = 'completed' AND f2.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY airport_a, airport_b ORDER BY airport_a, airport_b
Q26: SELECT COUNT(*) AS bonded_warehouses FROM lgr WHERE zolllager_kz = 1
Q27: SELECT pers_nr AS employee_number, vorname AS first_name, nachname AS last_name FROM bes_mitgl WHERE lizenz_ablauf < '2025-12-20' AND dienstgrad != 'loadmaster' ORDER BY pers_nr
Q28: SELECT dg_class, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM sndg WHERE gefgut_kz = 1 GROUP BY dg_class ORDER BY dg_class
Q29: SELECT kto_cd, name1 FROM knd_stamm WHERE treue_stufe = 'platinum' ORDER BY kto_cd
Q30: SELECT ROUND(SUM(betank_kg * 0.001), 1) AS total_co2_tonnes FROM betankg WHERE flug_id IN (SELECT flug_id FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed')
Q31: SELECT storno_grund AS cancellation_reason, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_flights FROM flug WHERE stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY storno_grund ORDER BY cancelled_flights DESC, cancellation_reason ASC
Q32: SELECT flghf.iata_cd, ROUND(AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l), 4) AS avg_price_usd_per_litre FROM flug JOIN betankg ON flug.flug_id = betankg.flug_id JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf(fh_nr) GROUP BY flghf.iata_cd ORDER BY avg_price_usd_per_litre DESC, flghf.iata_cd ASC
Q33: SELECT zoll_land AS customs_country, ROUND(SUM(zoll_betr_usd), 2) AS total_duty_usd, ROUND(SUM(zoll_betr_usd * zollsatz_pct / 100), 2) AS total_vat_usd, ROUND(SUM(zoll_betr_usd) + SUM(zoll_betr_usd * zollsatz_pct / 100), 2) AS total_taxes_usd FROM zoll_anm WHERE anm_art = 'import' AND stat = 'cleared' GROUP BY zoll_land ORDER BY total_taxes_usd DESC, customs_country ASC
Q34: SELECT flgesbez, dienstgrad, COUNT(*) AS active_crew FROM flges JOIN bes_mitgl ON flges.flges_nr = bes_mitgl.flges_nr JOIN flghf ON bes_mitgl.basis_fh = flghf(fh_nr) WHERE aktiv_kz = 1 GROUP BY flgesbez, dienstgrad ORDER BY flgesbez, dienstgrad
Q35: SELECT l.kennz, ROUND(SUM(w.teile_kost_usd + w.lohn_kost_usd), 2) AS total_maintenance_cost_usd FROM lfz l JOIN wartg w ON l.lfz_nr = w.lfz_nr WHERE w.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY l.kennz ORDER BY total_maintenance_cost_usd DESC, l.kennz ASC LIMIT 5
Q36: SELECT v.versicherer AS insurer_name, COUNT(v.schad_id) AS claims, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN v.stat IN ('approved', 'paid') THEN v.ford_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_approved_usd FROM vers_schad v GROUP BY v.versicherer ORDER BY insurer_name
Q37: SELECT lgr.lgr_cd AS warehouse_code, flghf.iata_cd, COUNT(sdg_verfolg.ereig_id) AS rcs_scans FROM sdg_verfolg JOIN flug ON sdg_verfolg.flug_id = flug.flug_id JOIN flghf ON flug.urspr_fh = flghf(fh_nr) JOIN lgr ON sdg_verfolg.lgr_nr = lgr.lgr_nr WHERE sdg_verfolg.ereig_cd = 'RCS' GROUP BY lgr.lgr_cd, flghf.iata_cd HAVING rcs_scans > 150 ORDER BY rcs_scans DESC, lgr.lgr_cd ASC
Q38: SELECT lftyp.mdl, SUM(betank.verbr_kg) * 100 / SUM(flg.entf_km) AS fuel_kg_per_100km FROM lfz_typ lftyp JOIN lfz lfz ON lftyp.typ_nr = lfz.typ_nr JOIN flug flg ON lfz.lfz_nr = flg.lfz_nr JOIN betankg betank ON flg.flug_id = betank.flug_id WHERE flg.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lftyp.mdl ORDER BY fuel_kg_per_100km DESC, lftyp.mdl ASC
Q39: SELECT f.allianz, b.pers_nr, ROUND(SUM(b.block_min) / 60, 1) AS block_hours FROM flges f JOIN bes_mitgl b ON f.flges_nr = b.flges_nr JOIN bes_eins e ON b.pers_nr = e.pers_nr WHERE b.dienstgrad = 'captain' AND e.eins_stat = 'completed' GROUP BY f.allianz, b.pers_nr ORDER BY f.allianz, b.pers_nr
Q40: SELECT lft.mdl, ROUND(SUM(bet.verbr_kg) * 1000 / SUM(snd.fracht_gew_kg / 1000 * flg.entf_km), 1) AS grams_per_tonne_km FROM lfz_typ lft JOIN lfz lfz ON lft.typ_nr = lfz.typ_nr JOIN flug flg ON lfz.lfz_nr = flg.lfz_nr JOIN betankg bet ON flg.flug_id = bet.flug_id JOIN sndg snd ON bet.sndg_nr = snd.sndg_nr WHERE flg.stat = 'completed' AND snd.fracht_gew_kg > 0 GROUP BY lft.mdl ORDER BY grams_per_tonne_km ASC, lft.mdl ASC
Q41: SELECT s.serv_lvl AS service_level, COUNT(CASE WHEN sd.ereig_cd = 'DLV' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS delivered_shipments, COUNT(CASE WHEN sd.ereig_cd = 'DLV' AND sd.ereig_zeit > s.wunsch_lief_dat THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS late_shipments, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN sd.ereig_cd = 'DLV' AND sd.ereig_zeit > s.wunsch_lief_dat THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN sd.ereig_cd = 'DLV' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), 1) AS late_pct FROM sndg s JOIN sdg_verfolg sd ON s.sndg_nr = sd.sndg_nr WHERE sd.ereig_cd = 'DLV' GROUP BY s.serv_lvl ORDER BY s.serv_lvl
Q42: SELECT zoll_land AS customs_country, COUNT(sndg_nr) AS cleared_imports, AVG((strftime('%s', freigabe) - strftime('%s', eingereicht)) / 3600) AS avg_clearance_hours FROM zoll_anm WHERE anm_art = 'import' AND stat = 'cleared' GROUP BY zoll_land HAVING cleared_imports >= 50 ORDER BY avg_clearance_hours ASC, customs_country ASC
Q43: SELECT sndg_nr AS shipment_id, lbf_nr AS awb_number, SUM(CASE WHEN temperature_c IS NOT NULL AND (temperature_c < temp_min_c OR temperature_c > temp_max_c) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_range_readings, MAX(CASE WHEN temperature_c IS NOT NULL AND (temperature_c < temp_min_c OR temperature_c > temp_max_c) THEN LEAST(ABS(temperature_c - temp_min_c), ABS(temperature_c - temp_max_c)) ELSE 0 END) AS max_deviation_c FROM sdg_verfolg JOIN sndg ON sdg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr GROUP BY sndg_nr, lbf_nr ORDER BY sndg_nr
Q44: SELECT v.ursache AS root_cause, COUNT(v.vorf_id) AS incidents, SUM(CASE WHEN vs.stat IN ('approved', 'paid') THEN vs.ford_usd ELSE 0 END) AS total_approved_usd FROM vorf v LEFT JOIN vers_schad vs ON v.vorf_id = vs.vorf_id GROUP BY v.ursache ORDER BY v.ursache
Q45: SELECT s.awb_number, s.destination_iata, z.import_status FROM sndg s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sndg_nr, declaration_type, MAX(ereig_zeit) AS last_event_time FROM sdg_verfolg WHERE ereig_cd = 'DLV' GROUP BY sndg_nr ) d ON s.sndg_nr = d.sndg_nr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sndg_nr, declaration_type, CASE WHEN ereig_cd = 'DLV' THEN 'Handed over' ELSE NULL END AS import_status FROM sdg_verfolg WHERE ereig_cd = 'DLV' ) z ON s.sndg_nr = z.sndg_nr WHERE s.stat = 'delivered' AND (d.last_event_time IS NULL OR d.last_event_time < '2025-12-20') ORDER BY s.awb_number
